issue.title: wait_watch.__init__ imports is_terminal_state, but _types only defines the private _is_terminal_state
issue.description: Discovered while implementing an unrelated approved plan (202608/test_cost_contention.md); not caused by that work. src/sase/agent/wait_watch/__init__.py:11 imports `is_terminal_state` from sase.agent.wait_watch._types and re-exports it at __init__.py:30/60, but _types.py:160 only defines the private `_is_terminal_state`. Introduced by commit 4f32a6ec7 'feat(agent): add live TTY panel for sase agent wait' (2026-08-23 09:42:36 -0400); still present at HEAD 65367452b.

task_type_fields.impact: Breaks the mypy lint gate (just check / just check-full both fail at _lint-mypy) and collection for tests/test_agent_wait_cli.py, tests/test_agent_wait_live.py, tests/test_agent_wait_watch.py; also causes an AttributeError in tests/main/test_agents_dispatch_handler.py::test_dispatch_wait and a failure in tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection (marker-selection count mismatch from the uncollectable modules).
task_type_fields.repro: Run `.venv/bin/mypy` on a clean checkout -> attr-defined error naming is_terminal_state. Or run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_agent_wait_cli.py` -> ImportError: cannot import name 'is_terminal_state' from 'sase.agent.wait_watch._types'.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced while gathering test-cost Pass-2 recordings: just test-cost (tools/run_pytest cost) failed with 2 failed + 3 collection errors, all traced to the same ImportError (cannot import name 'is_terminal_state' from sase.agent.wait_watch._types). Confirmed via direct import (python -c "import tests.test_agent_wait_cli") and standalone rerun of tests/main/test_agents_dispatch_handler.py::test_dispatch_wait (AttributeError: module 'sase.agents' has no attribute 'cli_wait', same root cause). Did not block the plan's cost recording, which still gets written on session finish, but did abort the test-cost recipe before its report/budget-check steps.

Independent reproduction while splitting tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py at HEAD 062ae22c2 (later than the original 65367452b report). just check failed at lint (mypy): src/sase/agent/wait_watch/__init__.py:11 attr-defined — Module sase.agent.wait_watch._types has no attribute is_terminal_state; maybe _is_terminal_state? git status listed only the monitor supervise test split (tests/monitor/_supervise.py, test_monitor_supervise*.py, tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt); wait_watch is unmodified. Confirmed _types.py:160 still defines only _is_terminal_state. Commit 42b900fa1 restored the public name, then 1d00fb2c4 re-privatized it and re-broke the export. I did not fix it; out of scope for the test-file split.
